locations.title: Taal Volcano Viewpoint
locations.description: Offering breathtaking panoramic views of the famous Taal Volcano and Lake, a must-visit scenic spot in Cavite.

locations.title: Aguinaldo Shrine
locations.description: The historic site of the Proclamation of Philippine Independence on June 12, 1898. A national shrine and museum.

locations.title: Corregidor Island
locations.description: A historic island fortress with well-preserved barracks, secret tunnels, and artillery from World War II.

locations.title: Balite Falls
locations.description: A serene natural destination featuring cool, cascading freshwater falls surrounded by lush, tropical greenery.

locations.title: Imus Cathedral
locations.description: A historic Roman Catholic cathedral known for its beautiful baroque architecture and significant cultural heritage.

locations.title: Sky Ranch Tagaytay
locations.description: A popular amusement park featuring the giant Sky Eye Ferris wheel, offering stunning views of Taal Lake.

locations.title: Pico de Loro
locations.description: A dormant volcano and popular hiking destination, known for its iconic monolith and panoramic summit views.

locations.title: Sangley Point
locations.description: A historic naval station and developing international airport, playing a key role in the region's commerce and history.
